figurative_meaning_en: to remain silent or keep quiet
example_sentences_in_bangla: বাবা রাগ করেছেন, তাই সবাই দম খেয়ে বসে আছে।
মিটিংয়ে বিতর্ক চলছে, তুমি দম খাও।
example_sentences_in_english: Dad is angry, so everyone is keeping quiet.
There's a debate in the meeting, so you stay silent.
history: This idiom originates from Hindi influence in Bengali language, commonly used in spoken dialects.
note: Noted as Hindi origin, adapted in Bengali usage.
